description:
Description

Where will Amazon's growth come from next year? In five years? Which product lines are staged to quintuple in size, and which ones are mature? Are we investing enough in our infrastructure, or too much? How will our customers react to changes in prices, or selection, or delivery speed? The SCOT Long-Term Planning and Forecasting (LTPF) team works to answer these key questions.

The Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) team owns Amazon's global inventory planning systems: SCOT decides what, when, where, and how much inventory to buy in order to meet customer needs as well as Amazon's business goals. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. Our systems are built entirely in-house, and represent the forefront of automated large scale supply chain planning and optimization systems.. SCOT LTPF is responsible for long-term forecasting and planning across Topline, Inventory, and Capacity — helping Amazon plan key metrics including ordered units and GMS, inventory units and cost, and FC building capacity and topology (size and location).

SCOT LTPF is looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer to support the team. LTPF BI Engineers build and maintain analytical tools supporting Topline, Inventory, and Capacity planning, and engage with internal stakeholders and external consumers of LTPF forecasts to ensure they have timely data in the right context to answer key business questions. The ideal candidate will have experience in leading analytics projects including but not limited to: forecasting, business monitoring, business intelligence and data visualization. The candidate should also have experience mapping analytical solutions to business problems in the most ambiguous environments with a track record of making data easy to consume for end users. This role’s responsibility includes performing data analysis (e.g., conceptualization, mining/modeling, and presentation of data) and developing methods to efficiently capture, manage, and analyze data.

The position serves as a trusted partner to business leaders by translating complex data into clear, actionable insights and identifying opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.

This is a 100% in-office position. Candidates must be able to work on-site at a designated company office during standard business hours.

Essential Responsibilities

Partners with stakeholders to define business problems, translate data needs into analytical solutions, and ensure alignment between business objectives and data outputs.
Develops and maintains methods to distribute management information, as appropriate, throughout P&C Operations using tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Designs, develops, and maintains dashboards (Power BI), reports, and data products for use throughout P&C Operations using the tools, standards, and platforms in use at the time with minimal guidance.
Develops and optimizes SQL queries, Python/PySpark scripts, and data pipelines to extract, transform, and validate data for analysis and reporting.

Independently leads analytics initiatives, managing priorities, timelines, and deliverables from intake through deployment.
Responds to support questions promptly, courteously, and accurately, with an analysis of the results and any issues or changes made with minimal guidance.
Synthesizes analytical findings into clear insights and recommendations, tailoring communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ensure enterprise reporting and analytics adhere to defined data governance standards, business rules, and data quality expectations.
Validates data accuracy and completeness across source systems and downstream reporting layers, identifying trends, anomalies, and data quality issues. Performs quality assurance checks to validate completeness and accuracy of data and/or deliverables for release with minimal guidance.
Supports recurring operational data needs (e.g., month‑end, quarter‑end, and ongoing production reporting cycles) by ensuring timely, accurate delivery of analytics and reports.
Identifies trends, patterns, and opportunities within data to support process improvements and strategic initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities

Document, update, and utilize the policies, procedures, and processes used throughout P&C Operations.
Mentor junior analysts by reviewing policies, procedures, and processes and validating the queries/code, reports, and dashboards for accuracy and quality.
Proactively identify opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders to remedy the errors timely with minimal guidance.
Ensures that the data produced remains secure, respecting corporate privacy and security procedures.
Assists with training for stakeholders in areas such as proper data usage, SQL, or Power BI.
Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to ensure alignment between analytics solutions and enterprise data platforms (e.g., cloud data warehouses, semantic models, and BI environments).

Four to six years of relevant work experience

Experience in data quality control/governance, data mining, and modeling
Working knowledge of emerging analytics technology (e.g., Agentic AI/ML concepts)
Strong soft skills with clear, effective oral and written communication.

Experience in Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake Ecosystem, and Visual Studio Code
Strong understanding of Property & Casualty insurance data concepts and operational workflows is preferred.

Executive Office, Global Marketing

Marketing Analytics and Effectiveness, Associate, New York

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Executive Office plays an integral role in setting and advancing Goldman Sachs’ corporate strategy, and in preserving the firm’s distinctive culture. We are responsible for safeguarding the firm’s relationship with alumni, clients, shareholders, policymakers, and the broader public, while ensuring that our own people remain informed about the firm’s evolving priorities. We also partner with the businesses to source high-impact opportunities in line with the firm’s social and sustainability agendas.

About Goldman Sachs Marketing

Led by the firm’s first Chief Marketing Officer, the marketing function at Goldman Sachs is backed by momentum and a broad imperative to unify the discipline, driving a business-critical function focused on the firm’s future growth. As such, Global Marketing is focused on building out a data-and-technology enabled team of growth marketers, delivering value for the brand and the business. The organization consists of Corporate Reputation Marketing and business marketing teams, as well as center of excellence (COE) teams like paid media, research, and design. Together, these functions collaborate to build a unified, scalable, and consistent approach to marketing the brand and its offerings. Our mission is to drive commercial impact for the firm and the businesses we serve.

The Marketing Analytics and Effectiveness Associate will help protect and elevate the reputation of Goldman Sachs by combining marketing strategy, data and analytics, and emerging technology to improve how we measure, analyze, and make decisions. The team is responsible for building a culture of measurement that drives performance across the marketing organization. This role is central to establishing and reinforcing that culture, embedding data and insight into how we execute our strategy.

We’re looking for someone with a razor-sharp analytical mind and a systems-thinking orientation. This individual should be someone who naturally connects the dots across data, process, and business outcomes. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, highly driven, and obsessed with finding creative ways to make our marketing sharper, more precise, and more effective.

Just as importantly, this is a highly collaborative and client-oriented role. The right person can move comfortably between technical teams and key business stakeholders, build strong relationships, and translate complexity into clear insights and action.

Responsibilities

Drive Measurement and Insights: Analyze marketing campaign and audience performance, identify patterns and opportunities, and turn complex data into sharp strategic insights and clear recommendations.
Build and Test with Emerging Technology: Experiment with AI, automation, and other emerging capabilities, rapidly testing where they can create meaningful business value and translating successful experiments into scalable solutions.
Build AI-Enabled Measurement and Reporting: Design, build, and deliver automated, AI-enabled dashboards and reporting solutions that bring together disparate data sources, surface insights and trends, and reduce manual analysis. Continuously identify opportunities to make reporting more intelligent, digestible, and actionable.
Partner across Functions: Work closely with strategy, paid media, web, social, design, and external partners to develop and scale new capabilities, while building and maintaining trust among partners.
Execute with Precision: Take ownership, move quickly, and maintain an exceptionally high bar for quality and attention to detail — from initial thinking through final delivery.

3–5 years of experience in marketing analytics, measurement, strategy, data/analytics consulting, marketing technology or a related field.
Exceptional analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with an instinct for getting to the underlying question rather than simply reporting the data.
Genuine enthusiasm for AI and emerging technology, demonstrated through hands-on experimentation, curiosity and a desire to continuously learn.
Experience evaluating paid media measurement, web and digital analytics, SEO/AI search, social listening, brand lift studies or quantitative research and survey methodologies.
Experience using measurement platforms (e.g. DCM, SA360, Adobe, Google Analytics, Vivvix Media Radar, Sprinklr, BrightEdge, etc.).
Technical fluency or willingness to learn SQL, Python, BI/visualization platforms, APIs and/or AI/LLM tools; deep engineering expertise is not required.
Strong client service instincts and the ability to build credibility and productive relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complicated ideas and topics into clear insights and takeaways.
Strong ownership mentality, unmatched work ethic, and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment.
